definitions.explanation: A single layer or fold of something, as opposed to double or multiple layers.
An eyelid without a visible crease, common among East Asians. Short for {一重|ひとえ}まぶた.

examples.japanese: {一重|ひとえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一重|ひとえ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{八重|やえ}→八重：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are single-petaled and multi-petaled cherry blossoms.
A single-layer kimono is worn in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一重|ひとえ}⟦まぶた→瞼：04269_mabuta⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{一重|ひとえ}⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I researched makeup that looks good with single eyelids.

examples.japanese: {一重|ひとえ}⟦まぶた→瞼：04269_mabuta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}られて→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Tape that makes monolids look like double eyelids is sold in stores.

notes:
SENSE 2 - EYELID USAGE:
In beauty and cosmetics contexts, {一重|ひとえ} is commonly used alone to mean {一重|ひとえ}⟦まぶた→瞼：04269_mabuta⟧ (single/monolid eyelid), contrasted with ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ (double eyelid with visible crease).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{一重|ひとえ}⟦まぶた→瞼：04269_mabuta⟧ (single eyelid/monolid)
・{一重|ひとえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (single-petaled flower)
・{一重|ひとえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (solely, entirely - adverbial use)

CONTRAST:
・{一重|ひとえ}: single layer/fold, monolid
・⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧: double layer/fold, double eyelid
・⟦{八重|やえ}→八重：noentry⟧: multi-layered (especially for flowers like ⟦{八重桜|やえざくら}→八重桜：noentry⟧)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, both {一重|ひとえ} and ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ eyelids are considered attractive. There is significant beauty industry focus on eyelid appearance, with products to create temporary double eyelid folds available.
